codes.description: Age-related osteoporosis without current pathological fracture
Other symptoms and signs concerning food and fluid intake
Disappearance and death of family member
Adverse effect of carbonic-anhydrase inhibitors, benzothiadiazides and other diuretics, initial encounter
Adverse effect of angiotensin-converting-enzyme inhibitors, initial encounter
Body mass index [BMI] 19.9 or less, adult

reason: Severe protein-calorie malnutrition (E43) was diagnosed only by the dietitian; the physician documented only poor PO intake/weight loss and BMI 18.6, and never confirmed the malnutrition diagnosis. A provider query is needed before E43 can be coded. Without it, R63.8/R63.4 and Z68.1 are used (BMI code requires an associated provider-documented diagnosis, which is questionable). Adverse effect codes for HCTZ (T50.2X5A) and lisinopril (T46.4X5A) are supported by the 'due to dehydration plus ACEi/thiazide' statement, but the attribution is weak. Depression is unspecified (F32.A). Z63.4 reflects bereavement.
